title: 건널목 개량촉진법 / queue:ADDENDUM:12248:20140114:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Road Act) <Act No. 12248, January 14, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date six months after its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 23
Omitted.

Article 24 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (4) Omitted.

(5) The Act on Promotion of Improvement of Level Crossings shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a), "a road to which the Road Act applies mutatis mutandis under Article 7 of that Act" shall be replaced with "a road to which the Road Act applies mutatis mutandis under Article 108 of that Act".

(6) through (126) Omitted.

Article 25
Omitted.
